newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIGA SHIPYARD IN 451,735 LATS H1 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: RIGA SHIPYARD IN 451,735 LATS H1 PROFIT.

text.p: Riga Shipyard, on the official list, had a first-half profit of 451,735 lats on sales of 4.63 million lats, the stock exchange said on Monday.
The company's production costs amounted to 3.99 million lats and sales expenses were 14,675 lats. Administration costs came to 110,317 lats, the bourse said in a statement.
The shipyard had 100,395 lats of income from other business activities, extraordinary income of 62,070 lats and extraodinary expenses of 27,260 lats.
The bourse said the company's profit-before-tax and extraordinary items came to 617,182 lats and it paid 200,257 lats in taxes.
